cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: The Conspiracy Expands
cards.instruction: Use every denial, coincidence, and missing detail as proof that more people and higher stakes are involved.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You and your manager both say my train's cancelled. On your first shift I taught you to check who supplies a story. Who gave you this one?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The signal failed. It's on the departure board.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good, follow the source. They've got the board operators helping keep me from my interview. Don't stop at the first printed notice.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The same fault is delaying three counties.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Now you're looking beyond your own station. Three counties to stop one applicant—that needs government backing. Write that down before they change the board.

reason: Make the pupil relationship determine the kind of reassurance, trade, precision demand, expanding suspicion or hospitality being pursued. Preserve a responsive B and avoid explaining the pair to a reviewer in dialogue.
